title: Exporting sampled-model summaries
description: You can follow sample arrays into an archive and two labeled JSON summaries.

steps.description: You create artifacts and save the existing sample arrays in an NPZ file. The archive also includes a numeric metadata array.
The loop visits the positive-result and negative-result sample sets separately. You request lower, median and upper quantiles from each set.

steps.question: Does each JSON entry retain both a sampled summary and a point estimate?
steps.answer: Yes. It stores mean, median, the two interval endpoints and point_estimate under each label.

steps.description: You write the summary dictionary as JSON and list the directory. The supplied output names posteriors_samples.npz and summary.json.
